title: Many a time and oft
html_source:
A lift from The Merchant of Venice, typical of Joyce’s almost compulsive references to Shakespeare, but also typifying young Gerty’s lyrical efforts and lifts from school texts.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: …they were wont to come there… (Spell-check prefers the incorrect won’t, rather than wont.)

anchor.prefix:
the stormtossed heart of man, Mary, star of the sea. 

 The three girl friends were seated on the rocks, enjoying the evening scene and the air which was fresh but not too chilly.
